bio: This establishment surprises both for its spaciousness and its quiet location, as it is situated within the Clubhouse of the Baviera Golf course. Behind this name, which refers to the beautiful mythological nymphs, followers of Dionysus, the Greek god of wine, we find the proposal of two chefs, the ‘Pablos’ (Pablo Vega and Pablo Domínguez), who complement each other perfectly to offer a current Mediterranean cuisine, with some international touches (especially French and Asian), in which there is no lack of creative nuances. The à la carte is supported by two tasting menus: Aristeo (three courses) and Minerva (eight courses, with the option of a wine pairing).
